title: Flow times minutes
hook: A flow rate is not the final volume until duration joins it.

knows: that a model can declare hypothetical quantities
doesNotKnow: Convert a constant flow rate and duration into volume.

misconception: Litres per minute already states total litres used.
objective: Convert a constant flow rate and duration into volume.

claims.text: Two hypothetical constant flows are 6L/min and 3L/min, each running four minutes. Scaled model; illustrative constant flows; no fixture instructions.
claims.source: Declared hypothetical inputs and limits in resource-specs.json. No actual product, price, tariff, shelf-life, treatment or physical appliance specification is asserted. FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): verified; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md.

claims.text: The stage's two results are computed by the printed expressions. At Minutes=4min, A=24L and B=12L. Geometry follows the declared dimension relationships. Other pictures use a fixed full scale across the slider range; continuous fills and arcs show relative amounts rather than literal object counts.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/resource-specs.json contains this lesson's numeric AST; src/lib/lifehacks/resource-model.ts evaluates it. A=["*",6,"x"]; B=["*",3,"x"]; x denotes Minutes. At x=4, A=24, B=12. Values are fictional/ideal assumptions, not measurements. Display rounds to at most three decimals. Diagram scale: resourceGraphicScale in resource-model.ts takes the maximum modeled magnitude across both formulas and the declared slider range. For non-geometry figures, full-scale values are displayed; the scale stays fixed when the slider changes. Energy axis endpoints use resourceAxisEnd, including B=5×A hours in lh-watts-hours-trade; cylinder rx and ry both scale with radius in resourceCylinderDimensions. FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): verified; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md.

claims.text: A volume per minute multiplied by minutes gives volume. Keeping duration equal isolates the flow-rate difference. Actual flow can vary, so the picture demonstrates the stated arithmetic only.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/resource-specs.json contains this lesson's numeric AST; src/lib/lifehacks/resource-model.ts evaluates it. A=["*",6,"x"]; B=["*",3,"x"]; x denotes Minutes. At x=4, A=24, B=12. Values are fictional/ideal assumptions, not measurements. Display rounds to at most three decimals. The principle follows from those expressions and stated scenario limits. FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): verified; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md.

claims.text: A hypothetical constant flow of 8L/min runs for five minutes. What volume does it deliver? Correct: 40L. Litres per minute × minutes = litres: 8 × 5 = 40L. The rate alone is not the total.
